families.coreProblem: Minimize effective proper route length while preserving closure, causal exit, structural margin and recoverability.
families.objectiveFunction: J_M=int_Gamma sqrt(gamma_eff_ij dx^i dx^j)+lambda_h H+lambda_s S+lambda_r R
families.machineryConsequence: Field symmetry, clock quality, active-material authority, load paths and recovery sinks determine whether a mathematically valid metric solution can be held.

failureReview.mandatoryQuestion: Was the solution mathematically invalid, reference-corrupted, physically under-authoritative, structurally unsound, control-late, recovery-limited, or outside the certified environment?
failureReview.antiPattern: Do not classify every failure as drive overload or repair every failure by adding power.

families.coreProblem: Find survivable favorable gravitational/shear routes rather than manufacture the entire transit geometry.
families.objectiveFunction: J_G=int_Gamma(1+a_g chi_g+a_t chi_t+a_u u_r+a_f p_fork) ds
families.machineryConsequence: Improvement comes mainly from detecting and solving weak gravitational structure farther ahead and coupling or decoupling quickly enough to exploit it.

failureReview.mandatoryQuestion: Was the route model wrong, the mass map stale, the fork unresolved, coupling authority insufficient, or decoupling too late?
failureReview.antiPattern: Do not assume rising power draw proves a reactor defect before checking route geometry.

families.coreProblem: Estimate a moving Q-boundary, match phase velocity, maintain adhesion and preserve viable exit correspondence.
instrumentTradition: P3 shipwide Q-weather and phase skin
families.machineryConsequence: Range and safety improve when prediction horizon, adhesion reserve and correction bandwidth rise together; stronger adhesion alone can worsen emergency release.

failureReview.mandatoryQuestion: Was adhesion loss caused by boundary-state error, phase-reference disagreement, Q-weather, actuator loss, or recovery saturation?
failureReview.antiPattern: Do not increase adhesion authority without checking detachment and recovery margin.

families.coreProblem: Translate protected state through valid Q addresses while maintaining epoch, coverage and anti-alias constraints.
instrumentTradition: P4-P6 autonomous graph and anti-alias estimators
families.machineryConsequence: Distance improvement is graph-theoretic: better mathematics exposes safer address paths while clocks, cages, references and beacons make those paths executable.

failureReview.mandatoryQuestion: Was the target wrong in coordinate, address, epoch, coverage, authentication, or alias state?
failureReview.antiPattern: Never substitute a spatial coordinate for a Q address.

families.coreProblem: Minimize higher-dimensional route length subject to a well-conditioned return projection into ordinary spacetime.
families.machineryConsequence: The central upgrade is not merely accessing more dimensions but proving that shorter routes also have stable accurately recoverable return maps.

failureReview.mandatoryQuestion: Was the geodesic valid but the return map ill-conditioned, the embedding wrong, the reference uncertain, or the projector physically unable to hold the chosen route?
failureReview.antiPattern: Do not choose the shortest manifold geodesic without return conditioning.

families.coreProblem: Construct a temporary topology in which protected origin and destination volumes become sufficiently adjacent for transfer.
families.objectiveFunction: J_F=w_d d_Mprime(A,B)+w_c Sigma_end+w_o O+w_g G+w_r R
instrumentTradition: P1-P2 finite-volume and paired endpoint rigs
families.machineryConsequence: Higher tiers solve larger protected volumes, more distant endpoints, stronger gravity covariance and more candidate topologies before commit.

failureReview.mandatoryQuestion: Was endpoint covariance, occupancy, gravimetric distortion, origin closure, topology support, authentication or recovery margin invalid before commit?
failureReview.antiPattern: Do not describe post-commit Fold-Jump control as ordinary steering.

families.coreProblem: Create and stabilize a traversable throat whose geometry, chronology, throughput and mouth states remain jointly admissible.
families.objectiveFunction: J_W=w_r sigma_r+w_t sigma_t+w_c C_chron+w_q Q_queue+w_e E_loss
instrumentTradition: P3-P5 network telemetry and traffic laboratories
families.machineryConsequence: Strategic improvement migrates toward infrastructure: throat material, mouth telemetry, synchronization, reserve energy, traffic control and deep-space siting.

failureReview.mandatoryQuestion: Was the failure local throat geometry, mouth synchronization, chronology constraint, structural support, energy recovery, traffic loading, or environment?
failureReview.antiPattern: Do not describe gate performance solely as ship velocity.

families.coreProblem: Map a protected macroscopic state onto a valid remote state while bounding continuity, identity and reference error.
families.machineryConsequence: Better systems know the remote state more completely, represent the payload more faithfully and reject ambiguous mappings earlier rather than merely applying more energy.

failureReview.mandatoryQuestion: Was target state incompatible, continuity tolerance exceeded, reference provenance weak, occupancy ambiguous, or representation incomplete?
failureReview.antiPattern: Do not treat additional energy as a substitute for state knowledge.

requirements: Attach a named race, polity or manufacturer only when higher authority explicitly connects that entity to the family, implementation, institution, inventor, patent or research tradition.
Technology basis may alter embodiment and research medium but does not prove possession or invention.
Generated instances may record instance-local provenance but may not promote repeated generated associations to setting canon.
When attribution is absent, render a generic DERIVED school and expose named ownership as UNRESOLVED.
